hero.lead1: AJSEE helps you discover what’s coming up and what you might enjoy.
hero.lead2: Find festivals, theatre, concerts and sporting events at home and abroad.

story.headline: How it started
story.p1: The idea for AJSEE came over a beer in autumn 2024. That same evening, we came up with the name AJSEE and a design for the logo.
story.p2: We started AJSEE alongside our full-time jobs, working remotely with 180 kilometres between us. Getting from the first idea to a working project took time.

team.headline: The people behind AJSEE
team.shared: We decide on AJSEE’s direction and our partnerships together.

adam.name: Adam Brázda
adam.claim: He has been part of AJSEE from the very first idea. He believes in simple solutions that help people discover a world of experiences without unnecessary barriers.

jan.name: Jan Oujezdský
jan.claim: From day one, he has shared the vision of making culture, sport and entertainment accessible to as many people as possible. At AJSEE, he brings together ideas, accessibility and an eye for detail.

future.headline: Where we’re heading
future.text: We want to make it easier to travel for the things you enjoy. Over time, we’ll bring events, accommodation, transport and ideas for things to do nearby together on AJSEE.
